page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Page number top left. Running head is an ornamental woodcut border at top (no words). Text centred in headings and verse; a short note at the bottom right of the text block ("Esse") set as the last line of the page.

main_text.head: GEORGII BVCHANANI SCOTI
Iusta et Icones.
Epigrammatum Lib. II.
IVSTA:
Iacobo IIII. Regi Scotorum.

p.i: Ama orbe replet, morte sors occulit: at tu Define scrutari quod tegat ossa solum. Si mihi dent animo non impar fata sepulchrum, pulchrum, Angusta est tumulo terra Britanna meo.

main_text.head: Magdalenæ Valesiæ Reginæ Scotorum, xv i. ætatis anno extinctæ.

p.i: Regia eram coniux, & regia filia, neptis, Regia, sed & votis Regia mater eram. Sed ne transgrederer mortalis culmen honoris, Inuida mors hic me condidit ante diem.

main_text.head: Eidem.

p.i: IN me certarunt totas expromere vires Natura, & virtus, gloria, morsque suas.

page.notes: The first letter "I" of the opening verse of Ama and the large woodcut initial "E"/"I" are decorative; the initial is rendered as the first letter of the verse. Some verse text is uncertain due to the scan's faint print: "Ama orbe replet" line and "pulchrum" line may be misprinted in the original; "Iacobo IIII" numerals are as printed. Line "Si mihi dent animo non impar fata se-" continues to "pulchrum," and the hyphenated word is set as printed.
